threads.summary: What is the obsidian Shard, and why did it answer the Mark?
The Custodian warning glyphs: who sealed the alcove, and what were they warning about?
Skrit fled alive. Will he remember the mercy, or sell it?
Two sets of memories. Which instincts can Rikan trust?
